goal: Allow wallets to combine external signing devices with internal keys
Remove the restriction that forces external signer wallets to be watch-only and immutable
reviewability: Ready for review with CI passing and previous feedback addressed
agreement: Strong consensus across multiple reviewers with previous concerns resolved
Verified by testing on Ledger Flex hardware with hot descriptor signing (PraneethGunas)
Verified by testing Qt and CLI workflows (adyshimony, rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it unlocks hybrid key management combining external signers and hot keys in one wallet
Unblocks multisig and future MuSig2 wallet workflows that use hardware devices
